heading: FAQ accordion patterns
subtext: Question-answer modules for reducing conversion friction and support load.

items.title: How fast can we launch a new page?
items.description: Use the page scaffold command, update config copy, and choose section variants. Most pages can be drafted the same day.

items.title: Can we reuse section patterns across routes?
items.description: Yes. Keep shared patterns in configs and reference them across page JSON files with consistent cvariants.

items.title: How do we maintain quality as the library grows?
items.description: Run check scripts on every change and keep variant registration + config presets in sync.
